product.audience: Editors, private clients and stylists evaluating a numbered made-to-measure collection
product.decision: Understand the silhouette construction, textile behaviour and fitting process
product.conversion: Compose a look and request a private fitting dossier

signature.moment: Flat digital pattern pieces travel on scroll, fold around a code-native mannequin and stitch into a complete couture silhouette before entering a runway sequence

systems.hero: A pattern-cutting table and assembly ruler occupy the first fold, not a model campaign portrait
systems.navigation: Atelier chapter tape with look number and fitting coordinate
systems.contentDensity: Large pattern geometry and silhouette moments alternate with dense seam, textile and fitting notes
systems.geometry: Pattern notches, grain lines, bias grids, seam allowances, dress-form curves and runway timing marks
systems.motion: Bounded scroll translates and folds pattern pieces into a garment; explicit cut controls and textile choice provide equivalents
systems.coreInteraction: Visitors assemble the silhouette, choose textile, volume and finish, then receive a numbered fitting look

structuralDifferences: The first fold leads with a compact dress-form and explicit flat, drape and finished controls
Pattern pieces become a vertical stack rather than moving across a broad table
Runway cut becomes a swipe-like but button-accessible look strip
Fitting dossier unfolds inline like a pattern envelope rather than opening a drawer

artDirection.typography: Editorial system serif for collection voice, condensed grotesk for look titles and mono cutting-room notation
artDirection.material: Black cutting felt, ivory pattern paper, lacquer red thread, cobalt silk and chrome dress-form marks
artDirection.imageLogic: Garments, pattern pieces, runway light and fabric studies are code-native SVG/CSS with Framer state transitions; no campaign photography
artDirection.microcopy: Toile, bias, grain, dart, godet, hand fall, fitting, look, atelier hours and delivery language
artDirection.dataHonesty: Collection, textile, atelier time, pricing and availability are fictional sample content

interactions.name: Pattern-to-garment assembly
interactions.input: Scroll or choose flat, drape and finished construction states
interactions.stateChange: Pattern pieces translate, rotate, layer and change material around the dress form
interactions.visibleResult: The garment visibly emerges from construction rather than appearing as a static product

interactions.name: Look and fitting composition
interactions.input: Choose textile, volume, finish and fitting details
interactions.stateChange: Silhouette, swatches, atelier hours, look number and dossier update
interactions.visibleResult: A complete fictional made-to-measure look and fitting brief

assetStrategy: Two original editorial fashion frames extend the code-native pattern assembly into material reality: a runway motion portrait and an atelier handwork study, both local and assigned distinct crops.

assets.role: Finished silhouette in motion after the pattern assembly
assets.focalCrop: Full garment and controlled fabric trail occupy the central runway axis
assets.mobileSafeArea: Head-to-hem silhouette remains inside the middle 55 percent

assets.role: Handwork and textile proof beside the construction ledger
assets.focalCrop: Hands, cobalt silk, red basting thread and paper pattern meet diagonally
assets.mobileSafeArea: Hands and seam junction remain centered

adjacentTemplates.why: The existing fashion template uses campaign photography; this starts from pattern construction and resolves a made-to-measure fitting look.
Pattern geometry, fabric drape and atelier hours replace gem collection, wishlist and cart interactions.
No campaign image or purchase drawer; the signature is garment construction and fitting documentation.
Both reveal making, but soft pattern folding and runway timing are structurally unlike radial 3D mechanics and chronometry.
A cutting table and fitting dossier replace artist portrait choreography, player and ticket merchandise journey.
